package poseidon.authz.hello_saas

import rego.v1

# pm: standing pm.
allow_rules contains "role_pm_issues_comment" if {
	input.lifecycle == "standing"
	input.company == "hello-saas"
	input.role == "pm"
	input.tool == "issues.comment"
}

# pm: standing pm.
allow_rules contains "role_pm_issues_create" if {
	input.lifecycle == "standing"
	input.company == "hello-saas"
	input.role == "pm"
	input.tool == "issues.create"
}

# pm: standing pm.
allow_rules contains "role_pm_issues_read" if {
	input.lifecycle == "standing"
	input.company == "hello-saas"
	input.role == "pm"
	input.tool == "issues.read"
}

# pm: the crews the platform may fulfil under its authority.
allow_rules contains "role_pm_crew_request" if {
	input.lifecycle == "standing"
	input.company == "hello-saas"
	input.role == "pm"
	input.tool == "crew.request"
	input.args.crew_template in ["feature-delivery", "feature-review", "stewardship"]
}

# pm-1: at most 2 concurrent crews (spawn denials are
# first-class governance events).
deny_rules contains "crew_request_over_cap" if {
	input.tool == "crew.request"
	input.agent_id == "pm-1"
	input.active_spawns >= 2
}
